quote: Where the signal is a green turn arrow alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed only in the direction indicated by the arrow signal so long as the arrow is illuminated, but the traffic must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

activation.condition: The subject faces a green turn arrow alone and proceeds into the intersection.

obligation.description: Proceed only in the arrow direction while illuminated, yielding right-of-way to lawful adjacent-crosswalk pedestrians and lawful intersection traffic.

timing.description: Arrow illumination is frame-varying; priority applies while lawful participants use the crossing/intersection.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: green turn arrow alone facing the driver
judgment_calls_needed.note: Raw Native Green cannot establish arrow-only pixels or that the head governs this approach.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original occupancy and independent permission/source review; position alone is insufficient.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: other traffic lawfully using the intersection
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original other-vehicle trajectory and independent signal/priority review; position alone is insufficient.
Original temporal and causal review is needed; a moving-overlap proxy is not a verdict.
